caption_fb:
68 million records. Free. No login.

Geneteka is a Polish volunteer index of baptisms, marriages and deaths, with more than 68 million entries.

How to start:
1️⃣ Type the surname in its Polish spelling (Wiśniewski, not Wisnesky)
2️⃣ Choose the province your clues point to
3️⃣ Write down the parish and the year. That's your path to the original record.

No match? It doesn't mean the family isn't there. Not every parish is indexed yet.

Find Your Polish Village in 30 Days takes you through it step by step, then on to the archives.
